title: Father Serving Son Birthday Cake, 1950s B&W Snapshot, USA
description: A candid 1955 black-and-white family snapshot capturing a father handing a slice of birthday cake to his four-year-old son, Cary. They sit at a kitchen table with the decorated birthday cake between them, framed by a classic 1950s mid-century rounded refrigerator in the background. This image offers a charming glimpse into post-WWII American domestic family life and birthday celebrations.
